sources.title: How far does light travel in the ocean?
How much of the ocean has been explored?
How does pressure change with ocean depth?
How much water is in the ocean?

facts.statement: Okyanus gezegenimizin yüzeyinin %70'inden fazlasını kaplar; Dünya'daki suyun yaklaşık %97'si okyanustadır.
facts.quote: The ocean covers more than 70 percent of the surface of our planet. / About 97 percent of Earth's water is in the ocean.
facts.location: NOAA — How much water is in the ocean?

facts.quote: The average depth of the ocean is 3,682 meters, or 12,080 feet.
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — How deep is the ocean?

facts.statement: Okyanusun üst 200 metresine öfotik, yani 'güneşli' bölge denir.
facts.quote: The upper 200 meters of the ocean is called the euphotic, or "sunlight," zone.
facts.location: NOAA — How far does light travel in the ocean?

facts.statement: 200–1.000 metre arası genellikle 'alacakaranlık' bölgesi olarak anılır; 200 metrenin ötesinde kayda değer ışık nadiren bulunur.
facts.quote: is usually referred to as the "twilight" zone, but is officially the dysphotic zone / there is rarely any significant light beyond 200 meters
facts.location: NOAA — How far does light travel in the ocean?

facts.statement: Afotik bölge 1.000 metrenin altındadır; Güneş ışığı ulaşmaz, bölge karanlıktır.
facts.quote: The aphotic zone exists in depths below 1,000 meters. / sunlight does not penetrate; the zone is bathed in darkness
facts.location: NOAA — How far does light travel in the ocean?

facts.statement: 200 metrenin ötesine o kadar az ışık ulaşır ki fotosentez artık mümkün olmaz.
facts.quote: Such a minuscule amount of light penetrates beyond a depth of 200 meters that photosynthesis is no longer possible.
facts.location: NOAA — How far does light travel in the ocean?

facts.statement: Her 33 fitte (10,06 metre) basınç bir atmosfer artar; deniz seviyesinde çevremizdeki hava bedenimize basınç uygular.
facts.quote: For every 33 feet (10.06 meters) you go down, the pressure increases by one atmosphere. / At sea level, the air that surrounds us presses down on our bodies at 14.7 pounds per square inch.
facts.location: NOAA — How does pressure change with ocean depth?

facts.statement: Denizde ne kadar derine inilirse üstteki suyun aşağı doğru yaptığı basınç o kadar artar; balinalar bedenleri daha esnek olduğu için büyük basınç değişimlerine dayanabilir.
facts.quote: The deeper you go under the sea, the greater the pressure of the water pushing down on you. / Whales, for instance, can withstand dramatic pressure changes because their bodies are more flexible.
facts.location: NOAA — How does pressure change with ocean depth?

facts.statement: Okyanusun en derin yeri 10.935 metredir; Büyük Okyanus'taki Mariana Çukuru'nda, Challenger Derinliği denen yerdedir.
facts.quote: The deepest place in the ocean measures 10,935 meters (35,876 feet) / found in the Pacific Ocean's Mariana Trench, at a place called Challenger Deep
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — How deep is the ocean?

facts.statement: Biyolüminesans, bir canlının kimyasal tepkimeyle ürettiği ışıktır; okyanusta çok yaygındır; 200 ile 1.000 metre arasında yaşayan hayvanların %80'i biyolüminesanstır.
facts.quote: Bioluminescence is light produced by an organism using a chemical reaction. / bioluminescence is very common in the ocean / 80 percent of the animals that live between 200 and 1,000 meters (656 and 3,280 feet) depth are bioluminescent
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — What is bioluminescence?

facts.statement: Biyolüminesans 'soğuk ışıktır': çok az ısı yayar. Işığı asıl üreten bileşik lusiferindir.
facts.quote: Bioluminescence is a "cold light." Cold light means less than 20% of the light generates thermal radiation, or heat. / Luciferin is the compound that actually produces light.

facts.statement: Canlılar biyolüminesansı av yakalamak, avcılardan korunmak ve eş bulmak için kullanır; yine de asıl amacı ya da işlevi tam olarak bilinmiyor.
facts.quote: Bioluminescence is used by living things to hunt prey, defend against predators, find mates / we don't really know the main purpose or function of bioluminescence
facts.location: National Geographic Education — Bioluminescence; NOAA Ocean Exploration — What is bioluminescence?

facts.statement: Fener balığı avını çekmek için biyolüminesans kullanır; ipliğin ucundaki topu yakabilir.
facts.quote: The most famous predator to use bioluminescence may be the anglerfish, which uses bioluminescence to lure prey. / On the end of the filament is a ball (called the esca) that the anglerfish can light up.

facts.statement: Vampir kalamar, avcıları ürkütüp şaşırtan ve oyalayan yapışkan, biyolüminesans bir salgı fırlatır.
facts.quote: the vampire squid ejects sticky bioluminescent mucus, which can startle, confuse, and delay predators

facts.statement: Hidrotermal bacalar deniz suyunun magmayla karşılaştığı yerlerde oluşur; buradaki sıcak su, derinlikteki aşırı basınç nedeniyle kaynamaz; ilk kez 1977'de Galapagos Adaları yakınında keşfedildi ve çevrelerinde daha önce hiç görülmemiş çok sayıda canlı vardı.
facts.quote: Hydrothermal vents form at locations where seawater meets magma. / Hot seawater in hydrothermal vents does not boil because of the extreme pressure at the depths / Scientists first discovered hydrothermal vents in 1977 while exploring an oceanic spreading ridge near the Galapagos Islands. / the hydrothermal vents were surrounded by large numbers of organisms that had never been seen before
facts.location: NOAA — What is a hydrothermal vent?

facts.statement: Nisan 2026 itibarıyla küresel deniz tabanının %28,7'sinin haritası çıkarılmıştı; kâşifler derin okyanus tabanının %0,001'inden azını görmüştür.
facts.quote: As of April 2026, 28.7% of the global seafloor had been mapped / explorers have seen less than 0.001% of the deep ocean seafloor
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — How much of the ocean has been explored?

facts.statement: Derinler, uzaktan kumandalı araçlar gibi dalış araçlarıyla ve genellikle gemilere takılan sonarla incelenir.
facts.quote: deploy submersibles, like remotely operated vehicles / usually mounted to ships, that can reveal the seafloor in greater detail
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — How much of the ocean has been explored?

facts.statement: Bilim insanlarının tahminine göre okyanusta 700.000 ile 1 milyon arasında tür olabilir.
facts.quote: Scientists estimate there may be between 700,000 and 1 million species in the ocean
facts.location: NOAA Ocean Exploration — How much of the ocean has been explored?
